name: Mirae Asset Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Mirae Asset Securities Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of various financial services in South Korea and internationally. It operates through Wealth Management, Investment Banking, Sales and Trading, and Principal Investment and Others segments.
